name: inspect_signal_decoders
description: Discover installed sigrok protocol decoders or inspect one decoder's channel/option help on Linux. Omit decoder to list ID/name pairs; supply its exact ID for literal help lines with source line numbers. query is a case-insensitive literal substring. Page matches with offset/limit (default 50; null returns all remaining). Reports tool identity, version, diagnostics and examined/matching coverage. Uses configured REA_SIGROK_COMMAND and prlimit; no recording, binary target, hardware scan or acquisition. Each call probes again; decoder modules are trusted, not fully fingerprinted. Use returned IDs/options with decode_signal_recording.

decoder.description: Exact installed decoder ID for help; null searches the decoder catalog

limit.description: Maximum matching decoders or help lines returned; null requests all remaining

offset.description: Number of matching decoders or help lines to skip; defaults to 0

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring in decoder ID/name or help lines; empty selects all
